
# Rhytech Global Solutions

> Rhytech Global Solutions Inc. is a technology and digital solutions company based in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. The company helps businesses across Ontario and worldwide with custom software development, website design, mobile application development, cloud services, data migration, ERP systems, digital marketing, graphic design, and search visibility optimization.

Rhytech Global Solutions combines technology, digital experiences, and marketing strategy to help businesses improve operations, strengthen their online presence, reach relevant audiences, and build scalable digital solutions.

### 6. Cloud Services

URL: https://www.rhytechglobalsolutions.ca/services/cloud-services

Services may include cloud readiness assessments, cloud migration planning, infrastructure configuration, backup and recovery planning, monitoring, optimization, and security best practices.

### 7. SEO, GEO, and AEO Services

URL: https://www.rhytechglobalsolutions.ca/services/seo-geo-aeo

Rhytech helps businesses strengthen organic search visibility and improve how their information is understood across search engines, answer engines, and AI-powered discovery experiences.

Search visibility services include:

- Technical Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- Keyword research and search-intent mapping
- Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization
- Content structure and on-page SEO
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Website crawlability and internal linking
- Entity clarity and structured content

SEO focuses on improving a website's accessibility, relevance, and discoverability in search engines. AEO focuses on presenting clear, useful answers to relevant questions. GEO focuses on making content and entities easier for generative AI systems to interpret and potentially reference.

These practices support discoverability but do not guarantee rankings, AI citations, rich results, leads, or traffic.

Official Website: https://www.rhyvidya.com/

RhyVidya is an online Hindi learning platform designed to connect learners with live instruction and self-paced learning resources.

Stated features include:

- Live Google Meet classes
- A free video library
- Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced learning stages
- Online Hindi instruction

Confirm current availability, pricing, and learning terms on the official product website.

### RhyShuttle — Badminton Club and Tournament Platform

Product Page: https://www.rhytechglobalsolutions.ca/products/rhyshuttle

Official Website: https://www.rhyshuttle.ca/

Live Application: https://tcaob-badminton-leaderboard.vercel.app

RhyShuttle is a badminton club and tournament platform designed to streamline tournament administration and help players follow match progress.

Stated features include:

- Live scoring
- Automatic tournament brackets
- Player statistics and rankings
- Session RSVP
- Venue TV display

TCAOB is described by Rhytech as a pilot customer.

### RhySeva — Care Beyond Borders

Product Page: https://www.rhytechglobalsolutions.ca/products/rhyseva

Official Website: https://www.rhyseva.com/

RhySeva is a service concept designed to help people living abroad coordinate selected in-person tasks for loved ones in India.

Stated features include:

- Verified staff
- Receipts and task updates
- Live video updates
- Support for families living abroad

The stated launch cities are Chennai, Coimbatore, and Madurai. Confirm current availability and service terms through the official product website.
